rationale: Build on the recurrent-tail baseline by keeping the deepest reverse-tail replay fully active while delaying and damping shallower recurrent blocks. The intended edit adds `TAIL_RECUR_STAGE_WARMUP` and `TAIL_RECUR_BASE_GAIN`, changes `tail_recur_schedule()` so shallow recurrent blocks start near-zero and only rise later in training, and logs the new curriculum knobs.
title: Delayed Shallow Tail Recurrence Curriculum
